structure_policy_rationale: Original 图标本身就是高度抽象和符号化的几何图形（海豚剪影），符合 theme_rules 中 'preserve_when' 的条件。不需要像游戏角色那样进行语义重构，而是直接保留其拓扑结构，将平滑的矢量边缘转化为粗犷的手绘描边，并将品牌蓝映射为主题限定的深蓝色块。
preserve: 海豚向右上方跃起的动态姿态
身体与尾巴围合出的类圆形/螺旋状负空间
尾部尖端必须保留橙色色块（识别关键）
眼睛的相对位置及神态
整体图形的宽高比和重心
must_preserve: 海豚的整体外轮廓（头、背鳍、卷曲的尾巴）
尾部尖端的橙色/暖黄色点缀
recompose_allowed: 将光滑矢量边缘转化为抖动、粗糙的蜡笔/马克笔线条
将品牌标准蓝调整为主题指定的高饱和度深蓝/靛蓝
简化眼睛等微小细节为简单色块或留白
去除所有渐变、阴影和高光，改为纯色块平涂
restyle: 应用复古手绘涂鸦风格（Retro Hand-drawn Doodle）
模拟干性绘画介质（蜡笔/粉笔）的颗粒感和涂抹不均
使用不规则的钝角和圆角处理转折处
forbid: 禁止保留原有的平滑矢量质感或工业锐利度
禁止使用原本的亮蓝色背景（必须换为纯黑）
禁止添加水花、波浪、气泡等复杂环境元素
禁止使用渐变色、立体阴影或高光渲染
禁止改变海豚朝向（如改为向左）
禁止将海豚误画为鲸鱼、鲨鱼或普通鱼类
禁止移除尾部橙色/暖黄色点缀
generation_brief: A retro hand-drawn doodle icon of the Ctrip dolphin logo. Thick, rough black marker outlines with a naive, clumsy aesthetic. Body filled with solid deep indigo blue. Tail tip accent in warm yellow/orange. Pure black background. No gradients, no shadows, no realistic details. Simplified geometric shapes, crayon texture.
color_application: Map original brand blue to theme's high-saturation Deep Blue/Indigo. Map original white body to theme's Cream/Milk White or keep as negative space if contrast allows, but preferably solid fill. Map original orange tail tip to theme's Warm Yellow/Orange. All colors must be flat, solid blocks without gradients.
stroke_application: Replace original clean vector edges with thick, irregular, hand-drawn black strokes. Simulate the jitter and thickness variation of a marker pen or crayon. Ensure corners are rounded or blunt, not sharp.
composition_application: Center the simplified dolphin symbol on the pure black canvas. Occupy 60-70% of the area. Remove all background elements (waves, water). Maintain the original aspect ratio and right-facing orientation.
identity_application: Preserve the specific topology of the jumping dolphin: head up-right, body curving down, tail curling up to form a C-shape/negative space. Keep the orange/yellow accent at the tail tip strictly. Do not alter the fundamental silhouette.
fidelity_constraints: Must have thick, rough, hand-drawn style black outlines
Colors must be limited to the theme palette (Deep Blue, Warm Yellow/Orange, Cream/White)
No gradients, shadows, lighting effects, or glossy textures
Subject must be flat, naive art style
negative_constraints: No smooth vector lines or perfect symmetry
No complex details like water splashes or waves
No change in dolphin orientation (must face right)
No removal of the tail accent color
